decision: Approve and declare the four Pilot 2-C training-operation decisions B3, B4, B5 and B6 exactly as written below, and authorise their implementation as training contracts. This decision declares how F and Fbeta training artifacts would be paired, seeded, checkpointed and resumed. It does not authorise a training run, a generated trained artifact, a Pilot 2-C episode, a floor replay, a randomized graph, or any change to a frozen parameter, statistical constant, hypothesis or protocol document.

owner_decisions.title: Campaign-to-training seed pairing
owner_decisions.text: Pair evaluation seeds 9001, 9002 and 9003 with training artifacts for F and Fbeta. Derive each training seed by a documented SHA-256 namespace-based derivation from the master seed and the evaluation seed, mapping the digest deterministically onto the declared seeds.training pool. Do not use arbitrary offsets, evaluation randomness or an implicit default pairing. F and Fbeta at one evaluation seed share the derived training seed, as REV4 section 3.6.2 requires, but each condition receives its own independently traceable artifact directory, manifest and parameter file.

derivation.index_rule: first four digest bytes as a big-endian uint32, modulo the declared pool length
derivation.collision_rule: linear forward probe over the declared pool in declaration order; the first unused index wins
derivation.condition_scope: derived once per evaluation seed, independent of condition, so F and Fbeta share the training seed

owner_decisions.title: Training environment seeds
owner_decisions.text: Derive a deterministic, separate environment-seed stream for every training seed and training episode. The training stream is not the evaluation environment stream: it must never reproduce a Pilot 2-C evaluation episode seed, and no training environment seed may equal a declared evaluation seed.

derivation.seed_width: first four digest bytes as a big-endian uint32
derivation.separation: every derived value is checked against the Pilot 2-C evaluation environment seeds for seeds 9001-9003 and episodes 0-2

owner_decisions.title: Checkpoint policy
owner_decisions.text: Checkpoint after every completed training episode. Preserve the final checkpoint and every intermediate checkpoint needed for recovery and audit, together with complete provenance. No checkpoint is a training artifact and none may be loaded by the campaign loader.

policy.cadence: one checkpoint after every completed training episode
policy.retention: retain every intermediate checkpoint and the final checkpoint
policy.provenance: condition, campaign seed, derived training seed, init seed, master seed, protocol and training-config digest, environment seeds used, progress counters, and the derivation record

owner_decisions.title: Exact resumption
owner_decisions.text: Checkpoint and restore all relevant state: model parameters; optimizer state and moments; Python RNG state; NumPy RNG state; framework (PyTorch) RNG state; sampler state; and applicable environment RNG state. A checkpoint that claims exactness while any required component is absent must be refused. Define and run a verification procedure that compares an uninterrupted training run with an interrupted-and-resumed run. Do not claim exact resumption until that equivalence has been demonstrated for the run.
components: optimizer state dictionary including momentum moments
caller-supplied environment RNG state, or an explicit record that the environment exposes none

verification.method: run the same declared budget twice: once uninterrupted, once interrupted after a checkpoint and resumed from it with the declared restoration procedure
compared: every per-episode metric (loss, return, gradient norm, decisions, update index)
verification.claim_rule: equivalence is claimed only when every compared value is identical

scope.artifact_instances: one separate artifact per condition and evaluation seed

prohibitions: do not start F or Fbeta training
do not generate a real trained artifact
do not run a Pilot 2-C episode
do not run a floor replay
do not construct, read or substitute a randomized graph
do not modify REV4, D1, D2 or D3
do not modify a frozen neural parameter or statistical constant
do not change a hypothesis or the approved Pilot 2-C grid
do not add an experimental condition
do not discharge U7 or set design.n_seeds_selected
do not write a checkpoint under a campaign results root
do not treat a training checkpoint as a training artifact
does_not_authorise: a Pilot 2-C episode or floor replay
any change to a frozen parameter, statistical constant, hypothesis or protocol document
any change to D1, D2 or D3
authorises: the declaration of B3, B4, B5 and B6
the implementation of the B3-B6 training contracts
focused tests of those contracts that execute no real training
